topSignals.title: Cycle 3, round 2 of the weekly benchmark rotation — Reverion, Convion, Hexis, Doosan Fuel Cell, SK ecoplant and Weichai, plus two cross-company sweeps — found no new KPI datapoint
topSignals.text: , extending the "no changes" streak in SOFC_Benchmark_Records.md to 8 days (since Oct 13). Every item that resurfaced today was independently re-dated and confirmed already logged (see Stack & Cell Technology below).

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new company news. Direct fetch of elcogen.com/news confirms the Sept 21, 2026 Metrosert testing-cooperation announcement remains the latest post (29 days old). Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): topsoe.com/press-releases shows a new item since yesterday's check — a technology contract for Bharat Petroleum's sustainable-aviation-fuel (SAF) project in India, published Oct 14, 2026 — but this is Topsoe's hydroprocessing/SAF business, not SOFC/SOEC. No new solid-oxide-specific release found (59 days since the Aug 27 H1 2026 results / March 2026 SOEC pathway reset remains the operative figure for this monitor).
Today's dedicated rotation — cycle 3, round 2 (Reverion, Convion, Hexis, Doosan Fuel Cell, SK ecoplant, Weichai), 7-day lookback: No new items for any of the six.

Reverion: Results were the already-logged Sept 29 €150M/$175M Series B (recirculated via esgtoday.com/trendingtopics.eu) and the Sept 18 Doosan $78M SOFC-stack supply contract — both confirmed already on file.

Convion: No 2026-dated news; results were the 2024 HD Korea Shipbuilding/HD Hyundai acquisition of Convion (~€72M, already known background) and a 2015-vintage Fraunhofer IKTS/Plansee Hannover Fair item.
Hexis: No 2026-dated news; results were 2020-vintage Viessmann/mPower divestiture coverage and older H2-View/Empa background pieces.

Doosan Fuel Cell: No new item. The Sept 18 Reverion $78M stack-supply contract and an enkiai.com "2026 SOFC pivot" explainer both resurfaced as commentary, not new disclosure — already logged. A January 2026 CES item on Doosan Enerbility/HyAxiom (gas turbines, SMRs, PAFC — not SOFC) is out of scope and not new.
SK ecoplant: Results were the already-logged 2023-vintage SK ecoplant/GDS Singapore SOFC story and unrelated SK Eternix (separate subsidiary) hydrogen-funding items with no SOFC content.
Weichai: No new item; the Ceres-Weichai manufacturing-licence background and recycled enkiai.com "Ceres 2026 strategy" aggregator pieces remain the only results, consistent with prior checks.
Sweep 1 — "Reverion OR Convion OR Hexis OR SolydEra": No new items; surfaced only the above plus already-logged SolydEra Hannover Messe 2026 PMX-platform coverage.
Sweep 2 — "Doosan Fuel Cell OR SK ecoplant OR Weichai": No new items; same results as the dedicated checks above, confirming no additional disclosure.

Other key players (Bloom Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, FuelCell Energy, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin, Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol, Plansee, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC): not in today's rotation; no items surfaced incidentally beyond the FuelCell Energy Q3 note under Market & Financials below.
